The ancient Greek myth of Hephaestus and Aphrodite can be viewed as an allegory for the divine act of creation and God's bestowal of gifts upon humankind. Additionally, the name Handal can inspire us to be like Hephaestus, the giver of graceful gifts, by sharing our own gifts and blessings with others.
